note: Boomer's Game Vault reviews, chosen with Claude. Apply with functions/scripts/apply-vault-reviews.js (staging first; production later with --project production).

reviews.title: The Baby in Yellow
reviews.verdict: The cutest thing that ever tried to kill you.
reviews.review: Short, silly and genuinely creepy in the right places, and it knows exactly when to stop.

reviews.title: Amanda the Adventurer
reviews.verdict: Never trust a kids' show that knows your name.
reviews.review: Sharp puzzles, a slow-burn mystery and Wooly the sheep: unsettling in a way few games manage.

reviews.title: Inferis: Dead Below
reviews.verdict: Atmosphere for days, scares for minutes.
reviews.review: It looks the part, but at under an hour it's more mood piece than horror game. It was also the first game a studio gave me early access to, so it'll always have a place in the Vault.

reviews.title: Joyville 2
reviews.verdict: Summer camp, two timelines, zero happy campers.
reviews.review: Clever past-and-present puzzles and a properly eerie camp; it builds nicely on the first one.

reviews.title: Silent Breath
reviews.verdict: Don't Scream's scarier, prettier cousin.
reviews.review: Photoreal woods, a mic that punishes every yelp, and scares you can't predict. Pure stream fuel.

reviews.title: Tales Beyond the Tomb - Pineville Night Stalker
reviews.verdict: A small town, a long night, and someone watching from the dark.
reviews.review: Short, tense and grounded: the true-crime feel makes every noise outside the window land harder.

reviews.title: True Nightmare - Roadside Cafe
reviews.verdict: Every order is weirder than the last. Tip your waitress.
reviews.review: A cozy job that turns quietly menacing; the café routine makes the scares hit harder.

reviews.title: 9 Childs Street
reviews.verdict: Never go into the neighbor's house. Especially at night.
reviews.review: A short, sharp trip through a creepy house that does a lot with a flashlight, shadows and sound.

reviews.title: Amenti
reviews.verdict: Say cheese. Something else in the tomb is smiling back.
reviews.review: The camera mechanic is a great hook, and the tomb is gorgeous and genuinely unnerving.

reviews.title: April 24th
reviews.verdict: One house, one night, a stack of tapes you shouldn't watch.
reviews.review: Short and brutal: the VHS framing works, though it's more shock than story.

reviews.title: At Dead of Night
reviews.verdict: Check in. Don't let Jimmy check you out.
reviews.review: One of the best live-action horror games ever made, and Jimmy is an all-time great stalker.

reviews.title: The Beast Inside
reviews.verdict: The cabin-in-the-woods story horror fans deserve.
reviews.review: Beautiful, tense and full of twists: an underrated gem that deserves more attention.

reviews.title: Blood Bear
reviews.verdict: Went camping. Woke up as the main course.
reviews.review: An ambitious little survival horror game with a great setting and real tension; impressive for a solo first game. The developer even dropped into my stream while I played it, which made the night.

reviews.title: Bloodwash
reviews.verdict: The scariest laundry day in history.
reviews.review: Puppet Combo grime at its best: a short, nasty giallo slasher that gets right under your skin.

reviews.title: The Cabin Factory
reviews.verdict: Clock in. Inspect cabin. Run.
reviews.review: Anomaly-spotting with a story: the dread of peering at every detail never lets up.

reviews.title: Clink
reviews.verdict: Is it in her head or in the house? Yes.
reviews.review: Quiet and unsettling: more mood than scares, but the uncertainty sticks with you.

reviews.title: The Convenience Store
reviews.verdict: Restock the shelves. Ignore the man staring through the window.
reviews.review: Short, simple and properly unsettling, with the low-key J-horror that made Chilla's Art famous.

reviews.title: The Cursed Tape
reviews.verdict: A short tape with a few good scares.
reviews.review: Effective while it lasts, but over before it really gets under your skin.

reviews.title: Dead Space
reviews.verdict: Cut off their limbs, not your lights. Space horror perfected.
reviews.review: Motive rebuilt the Ishimura from the ground up and kept everything that mattered: the dismemberment, the dread, the silence of the vacuum. It's how a remake should be done, and as a fan who's finished every Dead Space, I'd call it the best way to play the original.
reviews.hint: The 2023 remake by Motive Studio (Steam app 1693980), not the 2008 original

reviews.title: Deadly Night
reviews.verdict: Check in at the motel. Check out under the bed.
reviews.review: A sleazy, nerve-shredding game of hide-and-seek with a killer, and Puppet Combo grime at its finest.

reviews.title: Demonologist
reviews.verdict: Bring friends, bring salt, bring a spare pair of pants.
reviews.review: A great ghost-hunting game that's even better with a squad, though it borrows a lot from Phasmo.

reviews.title: Devour
reviews.verdict: Run. Scream. Hide. Burn the goats. Repeat.
reviews.review: Chaotic, loud and endlessly replayable: one of the best co-op screamfests for a stream with friends.

reviews.title: Don't Scream
reviews.verdict: The game that turned my chat into a library.
reviews.review: Nobody breathes while you play this one, and that's the magic.

reviews.title: Evil Nun: The Broken Mask
reviews.verdict: Shh. Sister Madeline is listening, and she brought her hammer.
reviews.review: A polished mobile classic reborn for PC: tense, puzzle-packed and a great Granny alternative.

reviews.title: Fears to Fathom - Home Alone
reviews.verdict: The free horror game that started a franchise.
reviews.review: Simple, grounded and terrifying because it feels real: one of the best free scares on Steam.

reviews.title: Fears to Fathom - Norwood Hitchhike
reviews.verdict: Small town, cheap motel, very bad decisions.
reviews.review: Driving, hiding and keeping quiet into your mic: the episode where Fears to Fathom found its feet.

reviews.title: Fears to Fathom - Carson House
reviews.verdict: A hundred bucks to house-sit. Worst deal ever.
reviews.review: Takes its time getting going, but the creeping feeling that you're not alone is pure Fears to Fathom.

reviews.title: Fears to Fathom - Ironbark Lookout
reviews.verdict: Alone in a fire tower. Not alone in the woods.
reviews.review: The best Fears to Fathom yet: Firewatch's isolation turned into slow, creeping dread.

reviews.title: Fears to Fathom - Woodbury Getaway
reviews.verdict: Book the cabin. Read the reviews first.
reviews.review: The longest, most grown-up Fears to Fathom: less jump, more skin-crawling discomfort.

reviews.title: Road Of Fear
reviews.verdict: Just a camping trip with the boys. Famous last words.
reviews.review: Strong Fears to Fathom energy: good vibes around the fire, then a drive home you'll never forget.
reviews.hint: By ZestosYt on itch.io: https://zestosyt.itch.io/roadoffear (listed as 'Fear of Road' in the import CSV)

reviews.title: Find Yourself
reviews.verdict: An hour on the other side, and not one second to breathe.
reviews.review: Intense and creepy; it throws jump scares at you so fast the tension never gets a chance to build.

reviews.title: Five Nights at Freddy's
reviews.verdict: Watch the cameras. Close the doors. Pray the power lasts.
reviews.review: A masterclass in tension from almost nothing; every flicker of the camera is a heart attack.
reviews.hint: The original 2014 game by Scott Cawthon

reviews.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
reviews.verdict: Put the mask on. Wind the box. Don't look at the vent.
reviews.review: More animatronics, more chaos; tougher than the first, and a bit more frustrating with it.

reviews.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
reviews.note: Not finished yet: Wishlist, no score or review.

reviews.title: The Forest
reviews.verdict: The survival horror game every other one is chasing.
reviews.review: Endless, terrifying and better with friends: a true classic. My favorite game of all time, until Sons of the Forest came out.

reviews.title: Fork Road
reviews.verdict: A few clever puzzles, a few cheap scares.
reviews.review: Fine for an hour, but it won't stay with you.

reviews.title: Garten of Banban
reviews.verdict: Kindergarten's closed. The mascots never left.
reviews.review: Silly, creepy and short: a fun mascot-horror romp that's more meme than masterpiece.
reviews.hint: The first game (2023), not the sequels

reviews.title: Granny
reviews.verdict: The grandmother of modern indie horror.
reviews.review: Hundreds of millions of downloads for a reason: pure, perfect cat-and-mouse terror.
reviews.hint: The original by DVloper (2017)

reviews.title: Granny: Chapter Two
reviews.verdict: The Granny sequel that doubles the dread.
reviews.review: Two hunters with two different senses make every move a gamble: second best of the series.

reviews.title: Granny 3
reviews.verdict: The best Granny yet, and the hardest to leave.
reviews.review: A massive mansion, smarter grandparents and the most satisfying escapes in the series.

reviews.title: Granny 4: The Rebellion
reviews.verdict: Granny brought the whole family this time.
reviews.review: A fan-made Granny with four hunters at once: chaotic, scrappy and surprisingly tense.
reviews.hint: Fan game by Fighter Gamer (not DVloper); may need adding by hand

reviews.title: Granny 5: Time To Wake Up
reviews.verdict: Wake up. Granny's already up.
reviews.review: One of the best Granny fan games: a huge house, tons of items and a real challenge.
reviews.hint: Fan game by A Twelve Studio on itch.io: https://atwelve.itch.io/granny5 (may need adding by hand)

reviews.title: Granny: Escape Together
reviews.verdict: Granny's house, now with friends to blame.
reviews.review: Co-op Granny is pure chaos: one person drops a vase and everyone pays for it.

reviews.title: Granny Remake
reviews.verdict: Strange Granny, new house, a UFO you'll never see coming.
reviews.review: A great-looking, trap-packed reimagining with more ways out than ever, including one that's out of this world.

reviews.title: Helldivers 2
reviews.verdict: For Super Earth! Spreading democracy, one terrifying bug at a time.
reviews.review: More action than horror, but it's action horror all the same: the bugs are scary, the swarms are terrifying, and the dread when the next wave hits is real. I wouldn't want my action any other way.

reviews.title: HELLSEED
reviews.verdict: Italy, 1980. The doctor is missing. Something else is home.
reviews.review: A moody Italian-horror slow burn with puzzles and a presence that hunts you through the house.

reviews.title: Indigo Park
reviews.verdict: Mascot horror finally got its Disneyland.
reviews.review: A free game this polished shouldn't exist: great characters, great chases and a story you'll want more of.
reviews.hint: Indigo Park: Chapter 1

reviews.title: Joyville
reviews.verdict: Happy campers, unhappy reunion.
reviews.review: A nostalgic camp turned nightmare, with a teddy bear sidekick you'll actually miss.
reviews.hint: The first game (2023), not Joyville 2

reviews.title: Labyrinthine
reviews.verdict: Split up, they said. It'll be fine, they said.
reviews.review: Brilliant fun with a squad; the story mode's fine, but the random mazes with friends are where it shines.

reviews.title: The Last Visit: 98th
reviews.verdict: Snow, concrete and a feeling you're not alone.
reviews.review: A short, atmospheric walk with a great setting; more chills from the mood than the scares.

reviews.title: Limoria
reviews.verdict: The Shining meets the Backrooms, and the hallways never end.
reviews.review: Beautiful and eerie, but short, and that head-bob will test your stomach.

reviews.title: Locked Up
reviews.verdict: Patience is rewarded. Mostly with terror.
reviews.review: A slow-burn corridor loop with some great scares, as long as you don't mind the pace.
reviews.hint: By EMIKA GAMES (2020)

reviews.title: Lost Luminosity
reviews.verdict: The neighbors were right about the noises.
reviews.review: A short, moody apartment mystery that's more sad than scary, in a good way.

reviews.title: Metel - Horror Escape
reviews.verdict: The best 'put everything back' horror game ever made.
reviews.review: Every footstep from the maniac turns into a mad dash to hide the evidence: brilliantly stressful.

reviews.title: Metro 2033 Redux
reviews.verdict: Moscow's underground, and the horrors live underground too.
reviews.review: Brilliantly tense and atmospheric, even if the gunplay shows its age.

reviews.title: Metro: Last Light
reviews.verdict: More metro, more mutants, more mask-wiping panic.
reviews.review: Bigger, prettier and more confident than 2033, with the same gasp-for-filters dread.
reviews.hint: Metro: Last Light Redux (2014), not the 2013 original

reviews.title: The Mortuary Assistant
reviews.verdict: Night shift at the mortuary, and the dead won't stay put.
reviews.review: A brilliant mix of routine work and pure terror; once the demon gets involved, nothing is safe.

reviews.title: Night Delivery
reviews.verdict: The worst delivery route in Japan.
reviews.review: Everyday streets made terrifying: one of Chilla's Art's most unsettling little nightmares.
reviews.hint: By Chilla's Art (2021)

reviews.title: Night Security
reviews.verdict: Your only job: watch the building. Something is watching you.
reviews.review: Chilla's Art's slow-burn dread at its best: every empty corridor feels occupied.
reviews.hint: By Chilla's Art (2023)

reviews.title: Order 13
reviews.verdict: Pick. Pack. Ship. Pray. Feed the cat.
reviews.review: A brilliant mix of warehouse grind and pure dread, and the cat makes every run matter.

reviews.title: Pacify
reviews.verdict: Fun first scream, fewer surprises after.
reviews.review: A blast the first few runs, though the scares wear thin once you know the routine.

reviews.title: Pieces of Me
reviews.verdict: Fewer jump scares, more lump in your throat.
reviews.review: A quiet, sad and unsettling walk through the past; less scary than EMIKA's others, but more affecting.
reviews.hint: By EMIKA GAMES (2024)

reviews.title: Poppy Playtime
reviews.verdict: Huggy Wuggy just wants a hug. A very long, very final hug.
reviews.review: The game that made Huggy Wuggy a nightmare icon: a tight, creepy hour that kicked off a whole franchise.
reviews.hint: Chapter 1 (the base game), not later chapters

reviews.title: September 7th
reviews.verdict: The Elf on the Shelf got a horror reboot.
reviews.review: Forty minutes of escalating holiday dread, with one doll you'll want to burn.
reviews.hint: By EMIKA GAMES (2023)

reviews.title: Silverpine Creek
reviews.verdict: Granny moved to the countryside and became a witch.
reviews.review: A creepy, physics-driven village chase that's better than its Steam score suggests.

reviews.title: SlackJaw
reviews.verdict: Open wide. The basement is calling.
reviews.review: Great atmosphere and a nasty villain, over a little too quickly.
reviews.hint: SLACKJAW by Nostromo Interactive (2025)

reviews.title: Sons of the Forest
reviews.verdict: Find the billionaire. Lose your mind. Build a treehouse.
reviews.review: The perfect survival horror sandbox: terrifying at night, gorgeous by day, and endlessly fun with friends. It knocked The Forest off the top spot as my favorite game of all time.

reviews.title: Stay Out of the House
reviews.verdict: The slasher escape room every horror fan should try.
reviews.review: Deep, replayable and terrifying: the game where Puppet Combo hit its peak.

reviews.title: Still Wakes the Deep
reviews.verdict: Great rig, great cast, mostly on rails.
reviews.review: A stunning, moving ride that's more Netflix miniseries than survival game.

reviews.title: Supernormal
reviews.verdict: Ask the ghosts a question. Pray they don't answer.
reviews.review: A gorgeous, photoreal apartment haunting where your own voice is both a clue and a trap.

reviews.title: Tattletail
reviews.verdict: Feed him, brush him, keep him quiet. Mama's listening.
reviews.review: A cult classic: the most annoying toy of 1998 and the scariest mom in horror.

reviews.title: Tales Beyond the Tomb - The Farm's Secret
reviews.verdict: The most uncomfortable episode in the series, on purpose.
reviews.review: Gripping and grim: being the killer's unwilling accomplice is horror of a whole different kind.

reviews.title: Tales Beyond the Tomb - The Last Vigil
reviews.verdict: Night shift at the cemetery. Not everyone is resting.
reviews.review: A creepy graveyard watch that turns a quiet job into a long, terrifying night.

reviews.title: Tales Beyond the Tomb - Route 86
reviews.verdict: Road trip with friends. Wrong turn. Wrong everything.
reviews.review: The biggest episode yet: multiple characters, real voice acting and a mic that punishes every scream.

reviews.title: There's Something in the Ice
reviews.verdict: Antarctica, a storm, and a sample that should've stayed frozen.
reviews.review: Gorgeous and tense, though the story stays on the surface.

reviews.title: The Twins
reviews.verdict: Bob, Buck, Granny and Gramps walk into a prison…
reviews.review: My favorite horror escape game, period. Steal the coin, the painting and the diamond while the twins hunt you, then turn on With Guests and watch it turn into pure chaos.
reviews.hint: By DVloper (the Granny developer), 2020; not Randumb Studios' The Twins

reviews.title: Wick
reviews.verdict: One candle, one night, five ghost kids. Good luck.
reviews.review: A classic stream-scare: simple, sharp and full of jump scares in the dark woods.
reviews.hint: By Hellbent Games (2015)

reviews.title: Witch's Doll
reviews.verdict: Don't play with the witch's doll. It plays with you.
reviews.review: A gorgeous, grimy UE5 nightmare packed with jump scares in under an hour and a half.

reviews.title: Zoochosis
reviews.verdict: Feed the giraffe. Check its neck. Run.
reviews.review: A fresh, creepy concept with fantastic creature designs, even if the zookeeping gets a bit repetitive.

reviews.title: Alien: Isolation
reviews.verdict: In space, no one can hear you scream. In VR, your chat can.
reviews.review: A perfect, punishing cat-and-mouse with the best Xenomorph in gaming; VR turns every locker into a panic attack.

reviews.title: Alien: Rogue Incursion
reviews.verdict: Game over, man? Not in VR. Not yet.
reviews.review: Aliens in your face, a pulse rifle in your hands: the most immersive Xenomorph fight in gaming. I loved every minute of it in VR.
reviews.hint: Part One, the VR original by Survios (2024), not the non-VR Evolved Edition

reviews.title: The Exorcist: Legion VR
reviews.verdict: Holy water can't fix a soft-lock.
reviews.review: Beautiful, unsettling and unplayable in the end: I hit a wall the game wouldn't let me past, more than once.

reviews.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted
reviews.verdict: The FNaF office was scary on a monitor. In VR, Freddy's right there.
reviews.review: The best way to play Five Nights at Freddy's: the original nights in VR are harder than ever, because you have to reach out and physically hit every button instead of tapping a key, and the jump scares land inches from your face.

reviews.title: Granny VR
reviews.verdict: Granny's scarier in VR. So are the bugs.
reviews.review: Hearing Granny creak past while you hide is great, but holding an item stops you breaking through boxes, and it streams as badly as it plays.
reviews.hint: Unofficial fan port of Granny for VR (SideQuest/itch.io); may need adding by hand

reviews.title: Half-Life: Alyx
reviews.verdict: Shh. Jeff can hear you.
reviews.review: Stunning, clever and surprisingly scary: the benchmark every VR game is still chasing.

reviews.title: Hello Puppets! VR
reviews.verdict: The best co-star in VR horror lives on my hand.
reviews.review: Funny, frightening and totally original: nothing else in VR plays like this. It's an older VR game and doesn't stream great, but in the headset it really hits.

reviews.title: Home Sweet Home
reviews.verdict: The scariest school in VR horror.
reviews.review: Relentless dread, a terrifying spirit and folklore you won't find anywhere else: a must for VR horror fans.
reviews.hint: By Yggdrazil Group (2017); played in VR

reviews.title: MADiSON VR
reviews.verdict: The scariest game ever made, and now you're inside it.
reviews.review: Every flash of the camera, every whisper, every jump scare is up close and personal: VR horror at its nastiest.

reviews.title: The Midnight Walk
reviews.note: Not finished yet: Wishlist, no score or review.

reviews.title: Narcosis
reviews.verdict: Deep sea, low air, high anxiety.
reviews.review: A slow, suffocating walk along the ocean floor that's all about dread; in VR, every breath counts.

reviews.title: Phasmophobia
reviews.verdict: The co-op horror game every other ghost hunt is copying.
reviews.review: Talk to the ghost, gather the evidence, survive the hunt: nothing beats a full Phasmo squad in VR.

reviews.title: Granny Legacy
reviews.verdict: Pepper spray, crossbows and Slendrina. Granny's been busy.
reviews.review: A fun, replayable twist on the original with plenty of new ways to die, though there are a few changes where I still prefer the OG Granny.
reviews.hint: Fan game by Candy on Game Jolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/grannylegacy/1011593 (needs DVloper's Granny on Steam); may need adding by hand

reviews.title: Hollowbrook - Apartments
reviews.verdict: Episode one, and Hollowbrook already has me hooked.
reviews.review: Moody, stylish and tense: a great start to a horror series I'll be watching closely.
reviews.hint: By Yetiface Games (2025), Steam app 3983920; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: Within of Static - Ashburg Rental
reviews.verdict: 616 GAMES does it again, and this one's even creepier.
reviews.review: A tight, realistic nightmare that proves the Tales Beyond the Tomb team has more stories to tell.
reviews.hint: Episode 1 by 616 GAMES (Dec 2025), Steam app 4092670; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: Total Chaos
reviews.verdict: Welcome to Fort Oasis. Nothing here is an oasis.
reviews.review: A brutal, grimy survival horror where every bullet matters and your own mind turns against you.
reviews.hint: By Trigger Happy Interactive (Nov 2025), Steam app 2208350; the remake, not the Doom II mod; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: SUFFOCATE
reviews.verdict: Taiwanese horror at its most unflinching.
reviews.review: Gory, unsettling and culturally fresh; a few rough edges, but a story you won't forget.
reviews.hint: By Naughty Cow (Oct 2025), Steam app 1965270; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: The Sushi House
reviews.note: Boomer's own wishlist pick: add with no score or review.
reviews.hint: By Noirbit (Nov 2025), Steam app 3687470; not 'The Sushi Bar' by KM Studios; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: Skinwalkers Valley
reviews.note: Boomer's own wishlist pick: add with no score or review.
reviews.hint: By Fireplay Studio (Nov 2025); not Skinwalker Hunt; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: Skinfreak
reviews.verdict: Overtime at the office. The killer's working late too.
reviews.review: Black Eyed Priest does it again: a grimy, funny, nasty slasher with a fantastic 80s B-movie vibe.
reviews.hint: SKINFREAK by Black Eyed Priest (Oct 2025), Steam app 4007340; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: The Skin Stapler
reviews.note: Boomer's own wishlist pick: add with no score or review.
reviews.hint: By Tainted Pact (Aug 2026), Steam app 4310610; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: Silent Nights
reviews.note: Boomer's own wishlist pick: add with no score or review.
reviews.hint: By JustTomcuk (Mar 2023), Steam app 2314180; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: ROUTINE
reviews.verdict: The moon base went quiet. You're about to find out why.
reviews.review: Worth the 13-year wait: the most atmospheric sci-fi horror since Alien: Isolation, with an 80s future you can almost smell.
reviews.hint: By Lunar Software (Dec 2025), Steam app 606160; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing

reviews.title: Rewind or Die
reviews.note: Boomer's own wishlist pick, pinned to the top of the Wishlist (Boomer's 'Up next'). No score or review.
reviews.hint: By Comp-3 Interactive, published by Torture Star Video (Apr 2023), Steam app 2329130; not the Rewind or Die demo by Overwrite Game Studios; probably not in the Vault yet, so add it if missing
